correctness.rationale: Generic three vectors projected onto a plane have unique linear dependency coefficients g=V^-1 u; all ±qi are extreme precisely when |g_i| satisfy strict triangle inequalities. Their inverse images yield exactly eight signed simplicial normal cones: two all-same sign and six mixed. Independently computed ray norms/dot products/determinants for both classes, confirmed trihedral solid-angle formula with correct atan2 sign branch, and obtained p(t)=(atan2(3sqrt3*t,L*(16t²-.5))+3atan(3sqrt3*t/(4.5L+3sqrt3)))/pi. The small-t linear coefficient, regular t=1/sqrt2 specialization and limit .5 follow by expansion. Independent Gaussian-normal convex-hull Monte Carlo used 18,000 directions at six t values (0.02 to 10), agreeing with p(t) within 0.009; finite sampling corroborates but does not prove the measure identity. The t=0 degenerate polytope is excluded.
residual_risks: Only one-parameter equiangular oblique family is classified; no uniqueness of interior minimizer proved.
